snippet.title: C64 Longplay: Starquake (99% completed)
snippet.description:
In order to get nigh-perfect completion I visited all 512 rooms, collected 230 items out of 240 (the other 10 are red herrings) and left intact all 21 pyramids (for exchanging items). 

Completed using save-states on an emulator. 

You see at 49:26 onwards I had a full tank of cloud platforms for climbing over some evil obstacles in the Z.A.P area, yet this isn't enough to get in and out of there without getting trapped forever. At 51:39 I had to use a floating platform hack to lift me out. 

Full guide here for those who are new to it: https://www.c64-wiki.com/wiki/Starquake

Speedrun here: https://youtu.be/iUK91tcwzLE
